verdict.rationale: Headless or programmatic automation is a fair question for a tax-filing portal, since agencies can offer filing APIs or bulk e-file channels, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only interactive, click-driven filing in My DOR ('click the Add Deduction button', 'Print Submission'), a manual file-upload option inside that interface, and a phone system. The probes found no OpenAPI spec, and the transactional host redirects every keyless request to an authenticated login. Nothing documents a headless, CI-friendly, or API-based way to run the service.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
